gizmo.title: Falanqaynta akhrinta
gizmo.description: Ardaydu waxay calan dhigaan weedhaha, baaragaraafyada ama sawirrada qoraalka ee caddaynta u ah summad kasta, ama waxay doortaan qaybta sida ugu fiican uga jawaabaysa su'aal.

configure.title: Su'aal
configure.description: Waxa ardayda laga codsanayo inay ka helaan qoraalka.

configure.title: Hawl
configure.description: Calan dhig caddaynta: ardaydu waxay calan kasta dhigaan agta caddayntiisa. Mid dooro: ardaydu waxay doortaan qaybta keliya ee sida ugu fiican uga jawaabaysa su'aasha.

configure.title: Ardaydu waxay doortaan
configure.description: Waxa ardaygu qoraalka ku tilmaamo. Sawirrada mar walba waa la dooran karaa.

configure.title: Calamado
configure.description: Summadaha ardaydu dhigaan. Isticmaal Calaamadee jawaabaha ee liiska qaybta si aad u doorato meesha mid kasta ka tirsan yahay.

configure.title: Qoraal
configure.description: Qoraalka ardaydu ka shaqeeyaan. HTML kasta: cinwaanno, baaragaraafyo, liisas iyo sawirro.

configure.title: Qaabka dhibcaha
configure.description: OER Schema: qaabka dhibcaha qiimayntan (tusaale dhibco, xaraf, boqolkiiba, dhammaystir).

configure.title: Ujeeddada waxbarasho
configure.description: OER Schema: ujeeddada waxbarasho ee la xiriirta qiimayntan.

configure.title: Koorso
configure.description: OER Schema: koorsada loogu talagalay qiimayntan.

advanced.title: Isku dayo
advanced.description: Inta jeer ee ardaygu hubin karo. 0 macnaheedu waa xad la'aan.

advanced.title: La isku laaban karo
advanced.description: U muuji su'aashan sidii saf furma oo xirma. Mid furiddiisa wuxuu xidhayaa su'aalaha kale ee la isku laaban karo ee ku dhow.

advanced.title: Ku bilow isku laaban
advanced.description: Marka la isku laaban karo, ku bilow saf xiran oo muujinaya su'aasha iyo xaaladeeda oo keliya.

developer.title: Magaca imtixaanka
developer.description: Magaca imtixaanka loo gudbiyo deegaannada xAPI si loo aqoonsado walaxdan
